scope: Current public demo routes and repository implementations; statuses describe bounded assessment results and evidence posture, not WCAG conformance.

statusDefinitions.pass: Self-evaluated as satisfied for the documented current scope with implementation, governing documentation, and current evidence; no framework-level conformance is asserted.
statusDefinitions.partial: Meaningful implementation or evidence exists, but criterion-specific scope, manual evaluation, operating evidence, freshness, or another material part remains incomplete.
statusDefinitions.gap: Criterion-specific implementation or evaluation has a known failure or missing requirement.
statusDefinitions.not-applicable: Triggering content or behavior is absent from documented current scope; reassess applicability when scope changes.

validationDefinitions.automated: partial means bounded axe-core evidence only; none means no criterion-specific automated accessibility determination is registered.
validationDefinitions.manual: required means browser and assistive-technology review remains mandatory before any criterion or conformance-level determination.

sources.attribution: Criterion IDs, names, and levels come from W3C WCAG 2.2; implementation/evidence annotations are WizardGang metadata.

freshnessRules.release-bound: Reassess before a tagged release when accessibility-relevant code or evidence changes.
freshnessRules.content-change: Reassess when public text, images, media, language, generated content, or document structure changes.
freshnessRules.interaction-change: Reassess when focus, keyboard, pointer, authentication, form, timing, status-message, or other interaction behavior changes.
freshnessRules.quarterly-manual: Repeat the documented manual browser and assistive-technology review at least every 90 days.
